daily.today_energy: Your mind is electric today, Gemini. Channel that restless brilliance into something creative—the universe is basically handing you the mic. Trust your instincts, even the weird ones.
daily.love: Someone's picking up on your energy and it's giving. Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability hits different today. Let people see the real you beneath the wit.
daily.career: Your ideas are *it* right now. This is your moment to pitch, propose, or pivot. The momentum is there—don't overthink it. Your voice matters more than you realize.
daily.health: Your nervous system's asking for a reset. Do something that grounds you—walks, journaling, whatever makes you feel anchored. Your body's wisdom is speaking; listen up.

weekly.overview: Mercury's direct energy has you feeling sharp and witty this week. Your curiosity is peaked, and conversations flow like never before. This is your moment to lean into those creative ideas you've been sitting on—the universe is literally asking you to speak up.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, your vibe is magnetic right now. If you're taken, deeper convos are happening naturally. Single? Someone's been noticing your energy. Either way, authenticity is your love language this week—no filters needed.
weekly.career: Things are clicking into place professionally. Your communication skills are unmatched, making it the perfect time to pitch ideas or have important conversations. Don't doubt yourself—your perspective is exactly what's needed right now.
